title: Match records by a selected key and define ordering separately
goal: Match records using a selected key with consistent equality and hashing, and choose an independent sort order and tie-break.

selectionNotes: The key-selector overload supplies both equality and hashing from one optional key comparer.
Equality does not define ordering. This sample explicitly chooses ordinal case-insensitive, null-first ordering and a ticket tie-break.
